test_cases.name: happy_path_one_for_one_worker_recovery
test_cases.description: Supervisor configured with one-for-one strategy intercepts single worker crash, reaps zombie tasks, respawns isolated worker without disturbing siblings, and certifies topology.
test_cases.input: Initialize supervisor sup-1 with strategy one-for-one, max_restarts 3, window 60s, and children [worker-1, worker-2, worker-3]. Simulate crash of worker-2.

test_cases.name: one_for_all_cascade_recovery
test_cases.description: Supervisor configured with one-for-all strategy intercepts worker crash, cascades teardown in reverse order across all siblings, reaps zombies, and respawns entire pool in forward order.
test_cases.input: Initialize supervisor sup-pipeline with strategy one-for-all, max_restarts 3, window 60s, and children [reader (order 1), transformer (order 2), writer (order 3)]. Simulate crash of transformer.

test_cases.name: rest_for_one_topological_recovery
test_cases.description: Supervisor configured with rest-for-one strategy intercepts crash of middle worker, stops only successor workers in reverse order while preserving predecessor, and respawns in order.
test_cases.input: Initialize supervisor sup-dag with strategy rest-for-one, max_restarts 3, window 60s, and children [worker-a (order 1), worker-b (order 2), worker-c (order 3)]. Simulate crash of worker-b.

test_cases.name: restart_intensity_exceeded_supervisor_crash
test_cases.description: Cumulative worker crashes exceed max_restarts within the sliding window, causing the supervisor to trip the circuit breaker, halt recovery, and crash.
test_cases.input: Supervisor sup-int configured with max_restarts 2 and window 60s. Worker crashes 3 times within 10 seconds.

test_cases.name: zero_zombie_process_reaping_enforcement
test_cases.description: Worker with spawned child tasks crashes. Supervisor asserts and reaps all sub-processes before allowing respawn to ensure zero zombie tasks.
test_cases.input: Worker worker-parent spawns subtask-1 and subtask-2 then crashes under one-for-one supervisor.
